_comment: Re-arm switch for the spec's 10% drawdown FREEZE (paper/daily.py).
When paper equity falls 10% below its peak, the evening run stops
opening new trades. Exits keep running. It stays frozen until a
person decides to resume: set rearmed_on to today's date, as
"YYYY-MM-DD" in quotes, and commit. The peak is then counted from
that date, so the account starts fresh from where it is.
Leave it null unless you mean to resume. Editable on github.com.
